messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

yo! 

i'm tal - your talent agent who's gonna find you a job that actually pays, not just give you career gyaan.

i know the bangalore tech scene inside out. which startups are dying, who's actually hiring, what they're really paying.

one of these days, i might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so... what's your full name?
Yatin Grover
yatin grover... solid name, sounds like someone who gets things done. where you working these days?
Flipkart

flipkart... the og indian unicorn that's still standing while others burned through cash. found you on linkedin - yatin grover, hands-on engineering leader at flipkart. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/yatin-grover-543a2978
Yes thats correct

hands-on engineering leader at flipkart... you're in the trenches building the backbone that keeps india shopping. from scaling those black friday crashes to probably dealing with the "why is my order taking 2 days" complaints. what made you stick with flipkart this long when half your batchmates probably jumped ship for higher ctc?
Looking for something outside of banglore.. in ncr region

User's LinkedIn Profile Context:
**EXECUTIVE SUMMARY**
Yatin Grover has a demonstrated history of working in the information technology sector. His current role is with Flipkart.

**ROLE-BY-ROLE**
*   Flipkart ([start date not specified]) – [Role title not specified] – [Responsibilities not listed]

**EDUCATION HIGHLIGHTS**
*   Institute of Technology and Management ([Years not specified]) – [Degree not specified]
how long you been working total?

12 years total experience and first priority is gurgaon
Looking for senior em roles or director roles there

12 years and ready for director level... gurgaon's perfect for that jump. tons of unicorns setting up shop there - paytm, oyo, zomato all have serious engineering leadership roles.

12 years experience + senior em/director roles + gurgaon priority... sound right?
Yes
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.

Yes
  Sure thats great
welcome to the club legend! you're all set - the good stuff starts rolling in soon.
Hi
Hi
hey yatin! what's up?

that's the "i've been refreshing linkedin all day and still nothing" face. i feel you.

the market's moving slower than usual right now - holiday season plus budget planning for next year. but your profile's solid - 12 years at flipkart, looking for director roles in gurgaon.

anything specific you're hoping to find?
Yes director or senior engineering manager roles

got it. director or senior em roles in gurgaon. you're looking at the right level - with your flipkart background, you should be getting calls.

what's the real reason you're looking to leave flipkart though? just the location or something else?
Mainly the location as plan to move back to native place which is gurgaon

makes total sense. moving back home after 12+ years in bangalore... that's a big shift. gurgaon's changed a lot since you left - basically mini-silicon valley now.

what kind of companies are you looking at? startups, established players, or just whatever pays director-level?
Anything with good work culture works
"good work culture" - the holy grail everyone wants but nobody can define. what does that actually mean to you? no politics? actual work-life balance? or just not being micromanaged?
Work life balance and less micro management

work-life balance and less micromanagement... that's the dream. especially at director level where you're supposed to be setting the culture, not fighting it.

i'll keep an eye out for companies that actually walk that talk. some of the newer unicorns are better about it than the old guard.

btw, what's your notice period at flipkart?
60 days

60 days is standard for your level. gives you time to wrap things up properly.

what's your current comp and what are you targeting? just so i know what's realistic vs delusional.
Upwards of 1 cr

1cr+ for director roles in gurgaon is definitely doable. you're in the right ballpark.

i'll slide roles when they're good... btw what's making you want to leave flipkart anyway? just the location or something else?
Location only

location only... that's clean. no drama, no politics, just life priorities. respect.

gurgaon's got a solid tech scene now - paytm, oyo, zomato, delhivery, even some international companies setting up shop there. you're timing it right.

i'll keep my eyes peeled for director-level roles that actually respect work-life balance. the kind where you're not expected to be on call 24/7 just because you're leadership.

anything specific you want me to avoid? certain industries or company sizes?
No nothing to avoid as of now.. quite open to everything

open to everything... that's smart. keeps your options wide.

you're locked in now. i'll start sliding roles when they match your vibe - director level, gurgaon, good culture, 1cr+.

curious though... what would your dream role actually look like day to day?

Engineering Manager ( Full Stack ) at Adobe

EM role at Adobe in Noida leverages your full-stack skills and leadership experience, a good fit for your career progression.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/IZ6sw
what do you think about engineering productivity roles?

hey, director role at toppan merrill

engineering productivity focus - making dev teams work better

remote/hybrid in india, so could work from gurgaon

hey, happy monday - if it’s not, we’ll work together on making it happen soon :)
